title: Become a partner · LiveLayer
description: Right now LiveLayer takes on 4–5 partners – festivals, venues and event agencies. The first ones get Insight and Plan for free.

hero.sub: Right now we take on 4⁠–⁠5 partners – festivals, venues and event agencies. The first ones get Insight and Plan for free. We get your honest feedback.
hero.alt: A crowd with their arms in the air under a festival tent

items.d: We hear about your events, and you hear what we can do.

items.t: You share sales from your last event
items.d: We help you find them. No new systems and no integration.
Every bar, every hour – and what it meant.
We go through the results with you and put the plan for next time on the table before the budget is set.

items.a: It is only free for the first 4–5 partners we take on now. In return we ask for honest feedback along the way. For later partners it will be a paid service.

items.q: We run many events a year – not one festival. Is it for us?
items.a: Yes. The more events, the faster Relay learns. Every event becomes a test the next one can build on.

items.q: Are our numbers shared with other festivals?
items.a: No. Relay shares lessons, not numbers. Other festivals never see your sales – only that a pattern exists, adapted to their own festival.

items.q: Do we have to change systems?
items.a: No. You keep the systems you have.
In the EU. We work with sales and counts – not with information about individual guests.

items.q: How much of our time does it take?
items.a: One conversation at the start, a little help finding the numbers, and a walk-through at the end.

contact.p: Write to us and we will find half an hour that suits you.
